title: 5 Cambodian schoolgirls killed as bus skids off road into a pond

blocks.text: KHSACH KANDAL, Cambodia — Five girls died on Tuesday morning in Cambodia when a bus taking them to school veered off the road and plunged into a deep pond, police said. The crash took place in Kandal province, about 40 kilometers (25 miles) north of the capital, Phnom Penh, said a statement posted on Facebook
